lead.why: A project's lead plans and supervises, which is the deep thinking.

rules.when: The task needs deep thinking: an architecture or design choice that is hard to reverse, a hard bug nobody has found yet, or planning how to split a large piece of work.
rules.why: The strongest Claude model, for the work where thinking matters more than speed.

rules.when: A second model's view helps: reviewing work another model did, or a problem the first model is stuck on.
rules.why: A different model family catches what the first one keeps missing.

rules.when: Ordinary building: implementing a feature, fixing a bug, writing tests, UI work, refactoring.
rules.why: Strong and quick, and light on the Claude usage window.

fallback.why: When nothing above fits, the everyday choice.
